title: The Intellectual Yet Idiot
coreMove: Discount expertise when the expert's downside is missing and the practitioner's correction loop is stronger.
sourcePressure: Credentialed experts become dangerous when their theories govern other people while the experts remain insulated from consequences.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Writing a generic anti-intellectual complaint rather than a consequence-based credibility test.

sourceAnchors.name: The Intellectual Yet Idiot
sourceAnchors.detail: The source bundle confirms an authorized chapter-linked excerpt and frames the type as credentialed but detached from consequences.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The type should feel dangerous because his errors are paid for by people outside his seminar room.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
